summary: Backend 14/14 PASS (checkout 422 for pickup + 200 with paystack URL for door; seller state machine acknowledge → request_courier → job opened w/ handover_code; rider accept → picked_up (order shipped, carrier 'Oromona Rider') → deliver w/ handover_code (order delivered, escrow_release_at set, courier_earnings row created); self-ship acknowledge → ship w/ tracking → deliver). Frontend outfit drawer at 390x800 ✅ — both Generate buttons in viewport (front y=672 h=56, multi y=736 h=56; bottoms 728 & 792 within 800). Checkout sheet ✅ — only static 'Door delivery by rider · Outer Nairobi · KSh 600' row, no pickup radios, item + delivery split total shown. Add-item wizard ✅ — hint '1st = front, 2nd = back' present, 'Add front' placeholder, 'FRONT · COVER' badge string in code (line 1001), 'Add the BACK photo too' error string in code (line 342). SELLER ORDERS SCREEN REGRESSION — the new workflow is documented in the file's header comments (lines 5-13) but the JSX still renders the OLD buttons: for a PAID order the UI shows 'Request rider pickup' + 'Acknowledge' + 'Mark as shipped' simultaneously (all three) — spec requires only 'Accept order' at paid, then 'Package ready · Call rider' + 'Ship myself' at in_fulfillment. Also stale copy: line 423 mentions 'Nairobi CBD pickup point' which violates the 'NO in-store/CBD pickup' rule.

ui_bugs.issue: Renders OLD workflow: 'Request rider pickup' (line 451), 'Acknowledge' (line 468), 'Mark as shipped' (line 485) shown together for paid state. Spec requires paid → only 'Accept order'; in_fulfillment → 'Package ready · Call rider' (primary) + 'Ship myself' (ghost). Confirmed live: 1 paid order rendered all three buttons at once. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(seller)/orders.tsx:436-489

Hint reads 'Rider requested — keep the parcel ready for pickup.' (line 430) instead of spec's 'Riders notified — hand the parcel over when the rider arrives' (which only exists as a toast in line 142). After 'call rider' the action buttons should also disappear entirely.
Line 423 still renders 'Buyer collects at the Nairobi CBD pickup point — drop the parcel there.' — user explicitly banned in-store/CBD pickup this iteration.

Line 491-506 shows 'Mark as delivered' for any shipped order. Spec says this should remain only for SELF-SHIPPED (no courier_job_id) orders — courier orders should NOT show a manual deliver button (rider enters handover code). Add `&& !order.courier_job_id` guard.

action_items: Rewrite (seller)/orders.tsx OrderCard action row per spec: paid → only 'Accept order' (primary, calls acknowledge); in_fulfillment && !courier_job_id → 'Package ready · Call rider' primary + 'Ship myself' ghost; in_fulfillment && courier_job_id → no action buttons, show 'Riders notified — hand the parcel over when the rider arrives' hint; shipped && !courier_job_id → 'Mark as delivered' (self-ship only); shipped && courier_job_id → no buttons (rider confirms via handover code).
Remove or repurpose the CBD pickup hint on line 420-425 — no in-store/CBD pickup in this iteration.
Update label 'Acknowledge' → 'Accept order' and 'Request rider pickup' → 'Package ready · Call rider' to match the spec (docstrings on lines 5-13 already describe the target labels).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend state machine in routers/seller.py:462-542 is CORRECT and matches spec (request_courier requires in_fulfillment; ship/deliver 400 for courier orders). The frontend just hasn't caught up to the API.
Backend delivery_option Literal['door'] in models.py:756 correctly returns 422 for 'pickup' — validated by test_checkout_pickup_rejected.
delivery.py::job_status picked_up handler correctly stamps carrier='Oromona Rider' and generates RIDER-<jobid> tracking number.
delivery.py::deliver_job correctly gates on handover_code match and inserts a courier_earnings row (validated end-to-end).

rca_of_issue: The header comment of /app/frontend/app/(seller)/orders.tsx (lines 3-15) documents the intended new workflow (Accept order / Package ready · Call rider / Ship myself) but the JSX render block (lines 436-506) was never updated — the old labels 'Request rider pickup', 'Acknowledge', 'Mark as shipped' remain. Additionally the 'Mark as delivered' button (line 491) fires for any shipped order without checking courier_job_id, which conflicts with the backend rejecting 'deliver' for courier orders (routers/seller.py:527-531).
